note: Two conditions and nothing else. 'glasspine-listening' sets no flags at all, which is legal and deliberate: the hollow's watchers care about it and the dice do not.

conditions.name: glasspine-listening
conditions.description: The hollow has noticed the creature. Nothing changes mechanically; everything changes about what happens next.
unmodelled: Every glasspine within a mile turns toward the listener over the next hour

conditions.name: glasspine-needle-struck
conditions.description: A glass needle sits under the skin, and moving drives it deeper.
